# Vaayu Chest & Sleep Specialists

> A chest, sleep and rehabilitation specialty centre in Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
> Vaayu treats asthma, COPD, interstitial lung disease (ILD), sleep apnea and allergies, and runs
> VORIC, an occupational-health initiative studying the impact of air pollution on Bengaluru's
> traffic police and other high-risk outdoor workers.

Contact: +91 63649 28680 | admin@vaayuchest.com | https://vaayuchest.com

## VORIC: impact of air pollution on traffic police in Bengaluru

VORIC (VAAYU Occupational Respiratory Illness Clinic), also written VOERIC (VAAYU Occupational &
Environmental Respiratory Illness Clinic), is a social-impact initiative of Vaayu Chest &
Sleep Specialists and the VAAYU Respiratory Foundation, running since November 2023. It studies and
addresses the impact of air pollution on Bengaluru's traffic police, BMTC and KSRTC bus crew,
construction workers, municipal and sanitation workers (Paurakarmikas) and professional drivers.

Key findings (presented October 2026 at the roundtable "Protecting Those Who Protect Our City",
Bengaluru, by Dr Ravindra Mehta):

- Reduced lung function was found in 28% of traffic police personnel, 29.5% of BMTC bus personnel,
  45% of Pourakarmikas (municipal sanitation workers) and 15% of construction workers screened.
- Higher rates of diabetes, uncontrolled blood pressure and overweight or obesity were also seen
  across these occupational groups.

Key facts:

- More than 11,000 high-risk workers screened free of cost since November 2023.
- Breakdown: 3,287 traffic police personnel, 4,389 BMTC and KSRTC bus crew, 3,000+ construction
  workers, 240+ Paurakarmikas.
- Five-year longitudinal research collaboration with the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) and the
  Public Health Foundation of India (PHFI) on the impact of pollution on traffic police personnel.
- Screening covers blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen saturation, BMI, random blood sugar,
  hypertension and diabetes screening, symptom and exposure evaluation, doctor consultation,
  spirometry, Forced Oscillation Technique (FOT), Fractional exhaled Nitric Oxide (FeNO) where
  available, chest radiograph, and relevant blood investigations.
- Operating model is STEM: Screen, Test, Educate, Medicate.
- Health effects associated with long-term exposure: asthma and COPD, reduced lung function,
  respiratory infections, heart disease and stroke, reduced productivity and quality of life.

Published and presented research:

- Respiratory and Multimorbidity Analysis in 2,450 Traffic Police Personnel in Bangalore City.
  Presented at the European Respiratory Society (ERS) Congress 2025, Amsterdam. Published in Lung
  India (Indian Chest Society Journal).
- An Observational Study on Respiratory Morbidity and Lung Assessment in 2,450 Traffic Police
  Personnel in Bengaluru City, the largest occupational-health screening study of traffic police in
  India. NAPCON, Pune, August 2025.
- The BREATHE Study: prevalence of respiratory symptoms, chronic health conditions and pulmonary
  function among bus drivers in Bengaluru and Karnataka. NAPCON, Pune, August 2025.

- [VORIC programme page](https://vaayuchest.com/voric): full detail, screening scope, research,
  policy engagement and FAQ.
- [Roundtable findings, October 2026](https://vaayuchest.com/newsroom/roundtable-protecting-those-who-protect-our-city):
  Vaayu's own account of the roundtable and the lung-function figures by worker group.
- [Karnataka statewide surveillance](https://vaayuchest.com/newsroom/karnataka-statewide-respiratory-surveillance-traffic-police):
  statewide respiratory surveillance for traffic police, Vaayu Respiratory Foundation as technical partner.
- [Research summaries](https://vaayuchest.com/research): the 2,450 traffic police study, the BREATHE
  bus-driver study and the five-year IISc and PHFI longitudinal study, in plain language.
- [Newsroom](https://vaayuchest.com/newsroom): news and announcements from Vaayu.
- [Social impact](https://vaayuchest.com/social-impact): community screening camps and outreach.
- [Media coverage](https://vaayuchest.com/media-spotlight): press reporting on VORIC and Vaayu.

## Clinical services

- [Specialty clinics](https://vaayuchest.com/specialty-clinic): asthma, COPD, ILD, sarcoidosis,
  pulmonary hypertension.
- [Sleep clinic](https://vaayuchest.com/sleep-clinic): obstructive sleep apnea, snoring, insomnia,
  parasomnias.
- [Pulmonary and cardiac rehabilitation](https://vaayuchest.com/pulmonary-rehab).
- [Allergy and immunology](https://vaayuchest.com/allergy-immunology): allergy testing,
  immunotherapy.
- [Preventive clinics](https://vaayuchest.com/preventive-clinics): tobacco cessation, health checks.
- [Home care](https://vaayuchest.com/home-care): home nursing, testing, rehabilitation.
